raw_output:
Giver: Hi, I've got your map here. Can you tell me where you are?
Follower: Hi. I'm at the start. I'm standing on the cross. It says "Start" on my map too.
Giver: Okay, good. So you're facing north. Let's look at what's immediately to your left.
Follower: To my left... there's a small spot. It looks like a burnt area.
Giver: Yes, that's the site of the forest fire. Keep it on your left as we move up.
Follower: Right. And to my right?
Giver: To your right, there's a playground. It looks like an adventure playground. Keep that on your right.
Follower: Okay. I see it. But wait, on my map, there's a footpath nearby. Is that relevant?
Giver: Ignore the footpath for now. Just follow the playground on the right and the fire on the left. Go a bit further.
Follower: Okay, moving up. The playground and the fire are still on my sides.
Giver: Keep going. Don't worry about the footpath behind you.
Follower: Alright. I'm passing a square area now. On my map, there's a farmyard ahead. Is that the finish?
Giver: No, that's not the finish. The farmyard is way down near the bottom edge. You're too low. Keep going up.
Follower: Okay, I'm going higher. The fire is still on the left. The playground on the right.
Giver: Good. Keep going straight up for a bit, then turn sharply to the right.
Follower: Turn right? But there's nothing there on my map. Just fields.
Giver: Ah, look closely. Just past the playground, there's a big open space. Is there a lake there?
Follower: Yes! On my map, there's an east lake. It's right there.
Giver: Okay, keep the lake on your right. Go up the side of it.
Follower: Okay, I'm hugging the lake on the right. The fire is still on the left.
Giver: Keep going up. Soon you'll hit a rocky area.
Follower: Okay... I see cliffs. Limestone cliffs. They're on my right now.
Giver: Good. Keep the cliffs on your right. Go over them.
Follower: I'm over the cliffs. Now... there's a quarry ahead on my map. It's right in front of me. Should I go there?
Giver: No, don't go straight there. That's not on the route. You need to go around it. Turn left, go past the quarry, then turn right again.
Follower: Around it? But the quarry is at (34, 41) on my map... wait, I don't have numbers. Just past the cliffs?
Giver: Just past the cliffs. Ignore the quarry for a second. Keep the quarry on your left as you go up.
Follower: Okay, so the quarry is on my left. I'm going past it.
Giver: Good. Now, after the quarry, look for a railway line.
Follower: Oh! There's a train crossing!
Giver: Yes, keep going up past the train crossing. It should be on your left now.
Follower: It is on my left. Okay, going up.
Giver: Keep going. Soon you'll reach a point where the path goes left.
Follower: Left? But there's a waterfall there on my map. Should I go to it?
Giver: No, keep the waterfall on your right. Go left, but don't go near the waterfall.
Follower: Okay, so I go left, but the waterfall stays on my right. I'm going up a bit.
Giver: Keep going up. You'll see another train crossing ahead.
Follower: Another one? Okay, I see it. It's further up.
Giver: Yes. Go past that second train crossing.
Follower: Okay, past the second crossing. Now... I see the finish line on my map!
Giver: Wait, what finish line?
Follower: There's a big cross marked "Finish" on my map. Is that it?
Giver: No, that's not it. That's just a landmark. The real finish is much further up.
Follower: Where?
Giver: Look back at the first train crossing. Did you pass it?
Follower: Yes, I passed the first one. Then the second one. But there's only two crossings on my map.
Giver: Ah, that's the problem. On my map, there are two crossings. On yours, there are only two as well, but they're in slightly different spots. You missed a section.
Follower: Missed? But I went past both.
Giver: Let me describe the route again. From the start, go up past the fire on the left. Keep the playground on the right. Go up past the lake on the right. Then the cliffs on the right. Then the quarry on the left. Then the first train crossing on the left. Then...
Follower: Then what?
Giver: Then go up to a third crossing. Do you have a third crossing?
Follower: No... there's only two.
Giver: Okay, so on my map, the third crossing is actually near the finish. You need to keep going up after the second crossing, even though there isn't a third crossing on your map. Just keep going up from the second one.
Follower: Okay, I'm going up from the second crossing. But I don't see any landmarks. Just fields.
Giver: That's okay. Keep going up. Soon you'll see the finish marked with a big cross.
Follower: There it is! The finish!
Giver: Good. Make sure the finish is on your left side now.
Follower: Yes, it's on my left. Okay, I'm drawing the line here. From the start, past the fire, past the playground, past the lake, past the cliffs, past the quarry, past the first crossing, past the second crossing, and now to the finish.
Giver: That sounds perfect.
Follower: Okay, I'm finishing it.
Giver: Great job.
Follower: Thanks! I can see the whole route now.
Giver: You're done.
Follower: Bye!
Giver: Bye!
